Package com.j3d.engine.scene.find

Class FindResult

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.find.FindResult
public class FindResult extends Object
A container class for the results of a search operation performed by the Finder. It encapsulates a found Layer, Thing, or GObject, along with their hierarchical indices, providing a structured way to return search outcomes. An empty FindResult indicates that no object matching the query was found.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
